title: The Mark on the Sluice
short_role: Choose command certainty or spare stone before the ram enters the ford.
setup: The sluice crew can mark the ram's approach now, or release a wagon of stone to the general stores.

choices.label: Mark Hammer Road (1 command)
choices.visible_result: The structural route is recorded clearly, but one intervention is spent before contact.
